summary: Verified bug fix: server.py now uses os.environ.get('MONGO_URL'/'DB_NAME') with defaults and wraps Mongo client instantiation in try/except. Regression suite (5 pytest tests) covering /api/status shape, idle state, OSC->status pipeline via test_osc_sender.py (opening_titles.mov/commercial_break.mp4, time_left math), LIVE status when total=0, and WebSocket /api/ws streaming all pass (5/5 in 7.71s). Additionally started a fresh uvicorn process with MONGO_URL and DB_NAME explicitly stripped from the environment: backend booted cleanly and GET /api/status returned 200 with the correct state payload -- confirming the Windows 'cannot start without .env' failure is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown; migrate to FastAPI lifespan handler when convenient.
Mongo client is created at import even though DB is unused; consider deferring creation to first-use or removing entirely until a settings page needs it.
OSC_HOST defaults to 0.0.0.0 (fine on Linux); Windows launcher/README should document adding a firewall rule for UDP 7250.
WebSocket endpoint has no server-side ping/keepalive - long-running kiosk clients could see stale connections behind proxies.
seed_data_creation: None. OSC simulated via /app/backend/test_osc_sender.py during pytest run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green (5/5). Env-less boot verified by launching uvicorn with MONGO_URL/DB_NAME removed from env — /api/status returned 200. The Windows startup regression is fixed. Note: pytest.ini uses xdist with 2 workers; if adding OSC-heavy tests, keep them in the same test class so LoadScopeScheduling groups them onto one worker to avoid UDP port collisions on 7250.
